comments.text: Tanzania shows a strange paradox: wildlife can destroy crops and livestock, but that same wildlife also supports families through tourism. If you lived there, would you see wild animals as a danger… or as something worth protecting at almost any cost?

comments.text: The color grading in the first few minutes felt a bit too saturated—nature in Tanzania is already breathtaking, no need to boost the yellows and greens that much! That tiny nitpick aside, the content itself is top-tier. You didn't just stay in a luxury lodge; you actually showed how real Tanzanians commute, work, and live. Highly informative!ll
